chat_bootstrap.rule: Any chat must resolve this manifest, detect an authorized local bridge, then prefer DIRECT_LOCAL_INGRESS or direct local inbox. Never assume localhost is reachable.

behavior.when_available: Use Local Bridge only when AUTO_ROUTE selects LOCAL_FALLBACK, or for explicit local recovery/debug.
behavior.when_missing: Return TRANSWARP_LOCAL_CONNECTOR_REQUIRED. Do not silently use HCDR.

transport_policy.name: AUTO_ROUTE_FINAL_V1
rules: Never run the same job_id/correlation_id on two routes at once.
A running job stays on its selected route until completion or explicit recovery.
When HCDR recovers, only new jobs return to HCDR.
GitHub remains SYNC_ONLY and does not determine DONE.
If both routes fail, return BLOCKED instead of looping.
